IVX HOLDINGS — PHASE 2 ENTERPRISE ACTIVATION

The production pipeline is now stabilized.

Do not reopen deployment work unless a verified regression occurs.

Shift the primary objective to:

1. Complete Android production APK.
2. Complete Android AAB.
3. Complete iOS/TestFlight build.
4. Complete physical-device QA.
5. Activate IVX IA Senior Developer as a permanent autonomous engineering lead.
6. Begin construction of the independent 50-Agent Application Factory.
7. As each agent becomes VERIFIED COMPLETE, immediately assign it to a real business workflow or application-development workflow.
8. Produce a live dashboard showing:
   - Agent name
   - Start time
   - Target completion
   - Current task
   - Last heartbeat
   - Evidence
   - Business assignment
9. Begin the first pilot application built completely from scratch by the AI Factory.
10. Continue two-hour executive reports with only verified progress.

Priority order:

Priority 1:
- APK
- AAB
- iOS
- Physical-device QA

Priority 2:
- IVX IA Senior Developer 100% completion

Priority 3:
- Build and verify the first 12 App Factory agents

Priority 4:
- Expand to the full 50-agent App Factory

Do not mark any agent complete until it has passed security, QA, and is actively performing real work.
